issue.title: Chapter assignment sync silently drops assigned_user_id / peer_checker_id for users not locally known.
issue.body:
## Summary

Chapter assignment sync drops `assigned_user_id` for any project member who is not the currently signed-in device account. The local `users` table is only populated for the active user at login (`syncUser` → `insertUser`), but chapter-assignment payloads from the API include **every** assignee and peer-checker id on the project. Repository code intentionally nulls unknown assignee ids before insert to satisfy the `assigned_user_id → users(id)` FK.

The result: View Project (and any UI deriving ownership from `assigned_user_id`) shows teammate-assigned chapters as **unassigned**, even after a successful sync or the background refresh added in [#273](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/273) / [#335](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/335).

Discovered while testing [#335](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/335) (assignment/stage refresh on chapter list open).

## Root cause

1. **Login sync only upserts the active user.** `syncUser` calls `FluentAPI.getUserByEmail` and `insertUser` for the signed-in account only — there is no project-member / roster sync today.
2. **Insert path nulls unknown assignees.** `insertChapterAssignmentSyncData` → `insertChapterAssignmentTx` calls `coalesceAssignedUserId(assignment.assignedUserId, knownUserIds)`, which returns `null` when the id is absent from the local `users` table (see comment at `repository.ts` lines 74–77).
3. **FK requires a parent row.** `chapter_assignments.assigned_user_id` references `users(id)` (schema + migration v4 rebuild). Without stubbing, the only safe options are null the id or fail the insert; the code chose null.

`peer_checker_id` is written through today (no FK, no coalesce), but `collectAssigneeIds` only gathers `assignedUserId`, so stub users are not created for peer checkers either. The fix should treat **both** role ids the same so we are ready if/when `peer_checker_id` gets an FK.

## User impact

| Area | Symptom |
|------|---------|
| **View Project** | Chapters assigned to teammates show ownership state `unassigned` (`deriveChapterOwnershipState` reads `assigned_user_id` only). |
| **Record tab** | `isChapterTakenByOther` may miss taken chapters when `assigned_user_id` was nulled locally (peer-check-only cases can still work). |
| **Offline claim** | `claimChapterOffline` allows a claim when local `assigned_user_id IS NULL`, even if the server already assigned the chapter to someone else. |
| **Repair loop** | `userNeedsAssigneeRepair` can force repeated full assignment syncs when all local rows lack assignee/checker ids, but re-sync still nulls assignees — repair never succeeds. |
| **#273 / #335 refresh** | Background metadata pull fetches correct server data, then repository layer strips assignee ids before persist — refresh appears broken for teammate assignments. |

## Repro

1. Use two accounts (A and B) on the same project; assign a chapter to **B** from web or another session.
2. Sign in on mobile as **A** (fresh install or cleared DB).
3. Complete post-login sync (or open View Project after #335 background refresh).
4. Open **View Project** for that project.

**Observed:** Chapter shows as unassigned (no “other” ownership indicator).

**Expected:** Chapter shows as assigned to another user (`ownershipState: 'other'`).

**Logs (optional):** `[Repository] Nulling assigned_user_id for users not in local users table` during `insertChapterAssignmentSyncData`.

## Proposed fix (Option A — agreed in Slack)

**Keep the FK.** Do not remove `assigned_user_id → users(id)`.

1. **Stub missing users** before chapter-assignment insert: for every distinct `assignedUserId` and `peerCheckerId` in the sync batch that is not already in `users`, insert a minimal stub row so the FK is satisfied.
2. **Remove `coalesceAssignedUserId`** and write both ids through from the API payload.
3. **Expand id collection** — `collectAssigneeIds` (or equivalent) should gather both assignee and peer-checker ids for stub upsert.
4. **Stub email constraint** — `users.email` is `NOT NULL UNIQUE` today. Use deterministic placeholder emails for stubs (e.g. `stub+{userId}@fluent.local`) in this ticket. Making `email` nullable is a **separate migration (v14)** — not required for v13.
5. **Tests** — update `repository.insertChapterAssignmentSyncData.test.ts` (currently asserts unknown assignee → `assigned_user_id` null) and remove/replace `repository.coalesceAssignedUserId.test.ts`.

### Explicit non-goals (separate tickets)

- **Full project-member profile sync** (names, emails, avatars from a roster API) — future enhancement; stubs are sufficient for ownership/checker ids.
- **Pericope data model / sync** — [#407](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/407) / [#408](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/408) depend on a separate engineering ticket for table creation + post-login sync, not this fix.
- **Nullable `users.email`** — defer to v14 if Product/engineering wants real emails on stubs later.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] After sync, `chapter_assignments.assigned_user_id` matches the API for assignees who have never signed into this device.
- [ ] After sync, `chapter_assignments.peer_checker_id` matches the API for peer checkers who have never signed into this device.
- [ ] Stub `users` rows are created for any referenced assignee/checker id missing locally; no FK violations on insert/upsert.
- [ ] `coalesceAssignedUserId` is removed; no code path nulls assignee ids solely because the user row is missing.
- [ ] View Project shows `ownershipState: 'other'` for chapters assigned to teammates.
- [ ] `userNeedsAssigneeRepair` no longer loops on devices that already have valid server assignment data.
- [ ] Unit tests cover stub creation + both ids written through; existing “null unknown assignee” test expectations updated.
- [ ] CI gates pass (`format:check`, `lint`, `architecture-guard`, `typecheck`, `npm test -- --ci`).

## How to verify

1. Two-account repro above on a device or emulator.
2. Confirm View Project ownership indicator for teammate-assigned chapter.
3. Confirm logs no longer report “Nulling assigned_user_id for users not in local users table” for valid server assignees.
4. Optional: inspect local DB — stub user row exists for teammate id; `chapter_assignments.assigned_user_id` equals server value.

## File pointers

| File | Notes |
|------|-------|
| `src/db/repository.ts` | `coalesceAssignedUserId`, `collectAssigneeIds`, `loadKnownUserIds`, `insertChapterAssignmentTx`, `insertChapterAssignmentSyncData`, `insertUser` |
| `src/db/schema.ts` | `users`, `chapter_assignments` FK definitions |
| `src/db/migrations.ts` | v4 chapter_assignments rebuild (FK + orphan nulling precedent) |
| `src/services/sync.ts` | `syncUser` (active user only), `syncChapterAssignments`, `syncUserChapterWork`, `userNeedsAssigneeRepair` trigger |
| `src/db/queries.ts` | `deriveChapterOwnershipState` via `mapProjectChapterRow` |
| `src/utils/chapterOwnershipState.ts` | ownership derivation |
| `src/utils/chapterTakenStatus.ts` | Record tab “taken by other” |
| `src/db/repositories/chapterClaimsRepository.ts` | offline claim gate on `assigned_user_id` |
| `src/db/repository.insertChapterAssignmentSyncData.test.ts` | regression tests |
| `src/db/repository.coalesceAssignedUserId.test.ts` | remove with coalesce helper |

## Related

- Discovered during [#335](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/335) ([#273](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/273))
- Prior FK/sync hardening: [#234](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/234)
- Pericope (out of scope here): [#407](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/407), [#408](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/408)

## API endpoints involved (no change expected)

- `GET /users/:id/chapter-assignments/all` — full project assignment snapshot (`syncChapterAssignments`)
- `GET /users/:id/chapter-assignments` — role-filtered assigned + peer-check lists (`syncUserChapterWork`)

Payload already includes `assignedUserId` / `peerCheckerId` (`ApiChapterAssignment` in `src/types/api/types.ts`).

comments.body:
**Test Results :#428**

- Verified that chapter assignment details are displayed correctly for the currently signed-in user.
- Verified that the chapter list displays the correct assigned user when assignment data is available locally.
- Verified that the assigned user ID is retained correctly in the local data.
- Verified that chapters assigned to other project members are displayed with the correct assignee when the required data is available.
- Note: Sync validation was not completed because the chapter assignment sync is currently failing.

Moving this ticket to passed QA
